project.title: G9v3.5 Physics pilot
project.subtitle: Newton's Laws pilot on the ZIP-free track, and the owner-bank guard (PR #305)
project.aim: A personal-use app for one Grade 9 kid to self-learn difficult Physics, Mathematics and Chemistry concepts for one of the toughest competitive exams. Not a corporate product.

M0.name: P1 kid page + first kid session
M0.full: P1: one page in the kid's words, opened as a plain file: 3 warm-up questions (NLM-001, 002 with the cue fix, 012), then one NEW question on the first missed idea with 3 staged hints, one retry and the full solution, then results and Save. OTM runs it, the Owner tries it, a non-author physics spot-check, then P2: a 15-minute kid session whose saved answers pick M1's first concept. At most one repair round per question.
M0.canDo: P1 brief ready; build not launched yet
M0.activity: P1 build waits for the Owner's launch (agy)

M1.name: NLM Core 1A/1B
M1.full: Each fixed pilot tile has a concept-building lesson and a matching inference-before-reveal task, checked as a pair; coverage and gaps are explicit.
M1.activity: to be re-planned in O5's roadmap (Q0 step 3)

M2.name: NLM questionnaire refinement
M2.full: Refine Core 1B/2B diagnostics using observed attempts after the first working learning path. Initial baseline and demand capture already occur in M0; they do not wait for this fuller questionnaire.
M2.canDo: No current refined Core-based diagnostic path evidenced
M2.activity: to be re-planned in O5's roadmap (Q0 step 3)

M3.name: NLM Core 2B
M3.full: Changed-demand transfer items address the observed gaps; a distinct spot-check covers the new decision and reveal behavior, followed by a learner retry.
M3.activity: to be re-planned in O5's roadmap (Q0 step 3)

M4.name: Next Physics topic (deferred)
M4.full: After the NLM learner cycle, select the next Physics topic from observed need and repeat the small pipeline; Mathematics and Chemistry remain later work.
M4.activity: to be re-planned in O5's roadmap (Q0 step 3)

Q0.name: Requirement with the Owner (Oracle O5)
Q0.full: New Oracle O5 builds the requirement with the Owner in small steps: 0 aim + 3 questions; 1 the kid and the exam; 2 one study session minute by minute (reacting to the P1 page); 3 roadmap where every step ends with something the Owner can open; 4 protocol, old history as links (reference, not direction). All agents new in R3, no reuse.
Q0.canDo: Step 0 ready for the Owner to paste into a new local Codex session
